model.name: literal cycle PWM contract
model.source: task-contract.json and cycle-contract.json, fixed before run
model.independence: Literal pulse widths and due cycles, no shared DUT arithmetic or latency calibration
model.signals: clk and PWM black-box outputs; command_valid observed only for frozen acceptance assertion
model.abstractions: No mechanical, voltage, pin, clock loss, or CDC/STA model

traceability.checker: each-cycle expected H/V low before17 and expected high at17
1000000cycle frame length with continuous expected PWM comparisons
sample valid on every risingedge,count exactly1 at drainedend

gaps: No external reset port, dynamic input, FIFO, IRQ, DMA or error/abort interface applicable
No mechanical position or pin correctness proven by simulation
Clockstop/resume not tested; no failsafe claim
Synthesis implementation timing BOARD NOT RUN
canary_method: Expected contract fault injection only; no DUT force. width+50cycles, period+1cycle, startup+1edge, valid+1edge. Normal pass required; each isolated canary required FAIL.
